verses.1: And these were the sons of David, who were born in Hebron. They were the descendants of Jesse’s second son, Daniel, and Abigail’s son, Carmel.
verses.2: The third was Abshalom, son of Ma’achah, daughter of Talmai, king of Geshur. The fourth was Adoniyah, son of Hagith.
verses.3: The fifth judge, Abital the Sixth, becomes angry when he sees a woman like that.
verses.4: He was born in Jerusalem. He ruled there for seven years and six months. In total, he ruled for thirty-three years in Jerusalem.
verses.5: And these were the sons who were born to him in Jerusalem: Shim’a, Shovav, Natan, and Shlomo. They were four sons of Shu’a, daughter of Imiel.
verses.6: And Elishaama and Eliphaz will be chosen.
verses.7: And it will be broken and destroyed.
verses.8: Elishama, Elidai, and Eliphalet – nine in total.
verses.9: All the sons of David were related to the sons of Philachshim and Tamar. They were brothers.
verses.10: And Shelemo’s son was Rehammed; his son was Avia; his son was Asa; his son was Yehoshaphat.
verses.11: Yoram’s son, Ahaziah; his son, Joash.
verses.12: Amasiyahu, our son; Azariah, our son; Yotam, our son.
verses.13: He holds onto us; Hizkiah holds onto us. Menashe holds onto us.
verses.14: May God bless his son Yosheiah.
verses.15: And the sons of Josiah were: Yohanan the second, Yehoyakim the third, Zadokiah the fourth, and Shalom the fifth.
verses.16: And the sons of Yehoyakim will be called “Zadkiyah” and “Beno”.
verses.17: And the sons of Yekhnya are Asir Shalteyel’s sons.
verses.18: And their kings, and Pediah, and Shenatsar, will be raised up. They will hear and respond.
verses.19: And the sons of Pedaiah were Zerubavel and Shimei. And the son of Zerubavel was Meshulam, and Hananiah, and Shlomit, their sister.
verses.20: And remember, the Tabernacle, and Mercy, and Grace will dwell in His kindness.
verses.21: And Ben-Hanania, Pletya, Yishaya, the sons of Rephaiah, the sons of Arnan, the sons of Obadiah, and the sons of Shekhniyah.
verses.22: And the sons of Sheknyah Shmaiyah, and the sons of Shmaiyah Chatush. And Yigal and Bariah, and Ne’aryah. And Sheshash.
verses.23: And Ben-Ne’ryah, Eloyeyani, Chizkiah, and Azriqam – three in total.
verses.24: And the sons of Elioenai were Hoduyahu, Eliyashiv, Pleyah, Akub, Yochanan, Delaya, and Anani. Seven in total.
